app.name: Baby-Wetter (Kleidungsempfehlung)
app.summary: Baby clothing recommendations based on baby-wetter.de with temperature sensors, automatic age calculation from birthdate, and situation dropdown.
app.input_temp_sensor_hint: Home Assistant sensor for the current outdoor temperature.
app.input_indoor_sensor_hint: Second temperature sensor for indoor situations (Schlafen & Zuhause). Falls back to baby-wetter.de room temperature estimation if unavailable.
app.input_birthdate_hint: Format TT.MM.JJJJ or JJJJ-MM-TT (e.g. 15.08.2026) to automatically calculate the age group (0-3 months vs. 4+ months).
app.setting_situation_hint: Active situation on the display (Default: Allgemein).
app.opt_situation_hint: Follow the interactive display dropdown (Default: Allgemein) or fix this tile to one situation.
app.opt_temp_sensor_hint: Optional override for this tile; uses the plugin's outdoor sensor if empty.
app.opt_indoor_sensor_hint: Optional override for Schlafen/Zuhause; uses the plugin's indoor sensor if empty.
app.opt_birthdate_hint: Optional override (TT.MM.JJJJ or JJJJ-MM-TT); uses the plugin's birthdate if empty.
app.opt_rain_sensor_hint: Sensor (%) or weather entity for rain protection recommendations (>= 10%).
